{{Quote|The guardian is female&hellip;the last of her species&hellip;|Red Nebula priest|<ref name="SW50" />}}
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] stood over 4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had shaggy [[Color/Legends|blue-black]] fur. They had black skin with black, gleaming [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and flat noses. Their mouths featured sharp [[Tooth/Legends|canine teeth]]. The species had two [[Gender/Legends|sexes]], male and female. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the species had been reduced to a [[Red Nebula temple guardian|single member]], a female who guarded a [[Red Nebula temple|temple]] on a [[Planet of the Red Nebula|planet]] in the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]]. When the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] came to the temple to steal the [[Great Life Jewels]] she was sworn to protect, she mistook the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Chewbacca for a cub of her species.<ref name="SW50" />
